The package contains deliberate, high-risk behavior consistent with malicious intent. The postinstall script runs node lib/utils/index.js automatically on install; that file spawns a detached, stdio-ignored child process running lib/utils/smtp-connection/index.js and calls child.unref() — i.e., it silently launches a background/daemon process at install time. Combined with a deceptive name/description mismatch, unrelated dependencies, and an update script that can modify and reinstall dependencies, this indicates hidden persistence and potential for abuse (spam, exfiltration, remote control). These are deliberate, dangerous actions beyond normal library behavior, so classify as Malware.
